svg.title: Meridian Retail Group — Figure 4 — Environments and promotion
svg.text: Environments and promotion: repository to production
everything deployed as bundles from Git · one commit promoted, never rebuilt · the identity changes at each step · gates are automated, not meetings (§9.4 D-10, §9.5, §5.7 D-08)
ONE COMMIT, PROMOTED — never rebuilt per environment
D-10 · Declarative Automation Bundles from Git
WEEKLY DRIFT JOB · compares deployed state against the repository and against the declared grant model
drift is a defect with an owner
migrated measures vs the legacy EDW
a breach pages the owning pod
The one rule that carries the most weight
WHAT THIS BUYS — measured, not asserted (§12.2)
over 80% for 3 months — the handover gate
D-08 · THREE REGIONAL PRODUCTION WORKSPACES, ONE METASTORE PER REGION
mrg-eu-nonprd — dev + test, bound to mrg_dev / mrg_tst
mrg-apac-prd — production where residency requires in-region processing
Three environments identical in shape; the environment boundary is enforced by the catalog hierarchy, not by discipline (D-05, D-10).
